Combines the lineage and subtype annotations, reassigns selected cells, and projects newly identified melanoma cells onto the metaprogrammes and trajectories.

**Inputs:** Objects and models from Xenium notebooks 01–03, plus lineage and outlier-coordinate dictionaries in `paper_data/Xenium/inputs`.

**Outputs:** Reconciled annotations and projected melanoma cells in `data/`, including `final_annotation.rds`; reassignment counts and the final melanoma embedding in `results/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Set these root folders before running the notebook.
data_root <- 'path_to_input'
output_root <- 'path_to_output'
code_root <- 'path_to_code'

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                    cache = FALSE, cache.lazy = FALSE, fig.align = 'center')
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = code_root)

```

## Combine the annotations

### Reconcile lineage annotations

```{r reconcile_lineage_annotations}

obj <- readRDS(file.path(intermediate_dir, 'annotated.rds'))
metadata <- obj[[]]
metadata$main_lineage <- as.character(metadata$main_lineage)
rm(obj)
gc()

# annotation sources
files <- c('myeloid_annotated.rds', 'endothelial_annotated.rds', 'fibroblast_annotated.rds', 'lymphocyte_annotated.rds', 'epithelial_annotated.rds', 'stroma_annotated.rds')
fields <- c('Myeloid_label', 'Endothelial_label', 'Fibroblast_label', 'Lymphocyte_label', 'Epithelial_label', 'Stroma_label')
source_fields <- c('Myeloid_label', 'Endothelial_label', 'Fibroblast_label', 'lymphocyte_label', 'Epithelial_label', 'Stroma_label')
cluster_fields <- c('Myeloid_cluster', 'Endothelial_cluster', 'Fibroblast_cluster', 'Lymphocytic_cluster', 'Epithelial_cluster', 'Stroma_cluster')
outside <- c('Non.Myeloid', 'Non.Endothelial', 'Non.Fibroblast', 'Non.Lymphocytic', 'Non.Epithelial', 'Non.Stroma')

# join annotations
for (i in seq_along(files)) {
    annotation <- readRDS(file.path(intermediate_dir, files[i]))
    if (files[i] == 'fibroblast_annotated.rds') fib_data <- LayerData(annotation, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'data')
    if (files[i] == 'lymphocyte_annotated.rds') lym_data <- LayerData(annotation, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'data')
    if (inherits(annotation, "Seurat")) 
        annotation <- annotation[[]]
    cells <- if ("cell_id" %in% names(annotation)) 
        annotation$cell_id
    else rownames(annotation)
    clusters <- if ("cluster" %in% names(annotation)) 
        annotation$cluster
    else annotation$Xenium_snn_res.0.8
    index <- match(cells, rownames(metadata))
    metadata[[fields[i]]] <- outside[i]
    metadata[[cluster_fields[i]]] <- outside[i]
    metadata[[fields[i]]][index] <- as.character(annotation[[source_fields[i]]])
    metadata[[cluster_fields[i]]][index] <- as.character(clusters)
}
rm(annotation)
gc()

# B-cell reassignment
b_cells <- which(metadata$Myeloid_label == 'B.Lymphocyte')
metadata$main_lineage[b_cells] <- 'Lymphocyte'
metadata$Lymphocyte_label[b_cells] <- 'B.Lymphocyte'
metadata$Myeloid_label[b_cells] <- 'Non.Myeloid'
metadata$Myeloid_cluster[b_cells] <- 'Non.Myeloid'

# fibroblast subtype centroids
common <- intersect(rownames(fib_data), rownames(lym_data))
fib_labels <- metadata[colnames(fib_data), 'Fibroblast_label']
subtypes <- setdiff(unique(fib_labels), c('Non.Fibroblast', NA))
centroids <- sapply(subtypes, function(label) Matrix::rowMeans(fib_data[common, which(fib_labels == label), drop = FALSE]))

# reassign fibroblast-labeled cells from the lymphocyte subset
cells <- rownames(metadata)[metadata$Lymphocyte_label == 'Fibroblast']
cells <- intersect(cells, colnames(lym_data))
correlations <- cor(as.matrix(lym_data[common, cells, drop = FALSE]), centroids)
calls <- colnames(correlations)[max.col(correlations, ties.method = 'first')]
metadata[cells, 'main_lineage'] <- 'Fibroblast'
metadata[cells, 'Fibroblast_label'] <- calls
metadata[cells, 'Lymphocyte_label'] <- 'Non.Lymphocytic'
metadata[cells, 'Lymphocytic_cluster'] <- 'Non.Lymphocytic'
rm(fib_data, lym_data)
gc()

# epithelial melanoma and mast cells
epithelial_melanoma <- rownames(metadata)[metadata$Epithelial_label == 'Melanoma']
metadata[epithelial_melanoma, 'main_lineage'] <- 'Melanoma'
metadata[epithelial_melanoma, 'Epithelial_label'] <- 'Non.Epithelial'
metadata[epithelial_melanoma, 'Epithelial_cluster'] <- 'Non.Epithelial'
metadata$main_lineage[metadata$main_lineage == 'Mast'] <- 'Myeloid'
write.csv(data.frame(reassignment = c('Myeloid to B cell', 'Lymphocyte to fibroblast', 'Epithelial to melanoma'), cells = c(length(b_cells), length(cells), length(epithelial_melanoma))), file.path(result_dir, 'lineage_reassignment_counts.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Metaprograms in reassigned melanoma cells

```{r metaprograms_in_reassigned_melanoma_cells}

cells <- epithelial_melanoma
mel <- readRDS(file.path(intermediate_dir, 'melanoma_analysis.rds'))
epi <- readRDS(file.path(intermediate_dir, 'epithelial_annotated.rds'))

# joint scoring population
cells <- intersect(cells, colnames(epi))
epi <- subset(epi, cells = cells)
modules <- mel@misc$metaprogram_gene_sets
comb <- JoinLayers(merge(mel, y = epi))
comb <- AddModuleScore(comb, features = modules, name = 'comm', assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'data', ctrl = 5, nbin = 10, seed = 1)
scores <- as.matrix(comb[[]][cells, paste0('comm', 1:7)])
colnames(scores) <- names(modules)
rm(comb, epi)
gc()

# program calls and scaling frame
calls <- max.col(scores, ties.method = 'first')
result <- data.frame(cell_id = cells, metaprogram_modulescore_stress_subtype = paste0('comm', calls), melanoma_mp = names(modules)[calls], scores, check.names = FALSE)
training <- trajectory_training_view(mel)
population_scores <- as.matrix(mel[[]][, training$features])
frame <- list(features = training$features, center = colMeans(population_scores), scale = apply(population_scores, 2, sd))

```

### Project reassigned melanoma cells

```{r project_reassigned_melanoma_cells}

library(destiny)
library(slingshot)
input <- list(metadata = result, scaling = frame)
dm <- mel@misc$trajectory_models$diffusion_map
fit <- mel@misc$trajectory_models$slingshot

# fixed scaling frame
scores <- as.matrix(input$metadata[, input$scaling$features])
rownames(scores) <- input$metadata$cell_id
scores <- scale(scores, center = input$scaling$center, scale = input$scaling$scale)
scores[scores > 3] <- 3
scores[scores < -3] <- -3
coordinates <- as.matrix(destiny::dm_predict(dm, scores)[, 1:3, drop = FALSE])
coordinates <- sweep(coordinates, 2, training$signs, '*')
colnames(coordinates) <- paste0('DC', 1:3)
rownames(coordinates) <- rownames(scores)

# Slingshot projection
projected <- slingshot::predict(fit, newdata = coordinates)
weights <- slingCurveWeights(projected, as.probs = FALSE)
pt_na <- slingPseudotime(projected, na = TRUE)
pt <- slingPseudotime(projected, na = FALSE)
assignment <- ifelse(is.na(pt_na[, 1]), 'Lineage 2', ifelse(is.na(pt_na[, 2]), 'Lineage 1', 'Shared Trunk'))
result <- data.frame(cell_id = rownames(scores), DM1 = coordinates[, 1], DM2 = coordinates[, 2], DM3 = coordinates[, 3], pt_route1_raw = pt[, 1], pt_route2_raw = pt[, 2], w1 = weights[, 1], w2 = weights[, 2], slingshot_lineage_assignment = assignment)

```

### Correct reassigned melanoma trajectories

```{r correct_reassigned_melanoma_trajectories}

df <- result
population <- trajectory_cells(mel, 'raw')
fork <- 0.05608277
threshold <- 0.0081

# population trunk
population <- population %>% mutate(pt_route1 = pt_route1_raw, pt_route2 = pt_route2_raw, pt_merged = (pt_route1 + pt_route2) / 2, pt_class = 'Shared Trunk')
trunk <- make_centerline(population %>% filter(w1 + w2 >= 1.5), 'Shared Trunk', 'pt_merged', n_bins = 70, span = 0.25)
s <- as.matrix(trunk[, c('pt_route1_s', 'pt_route2_s')])
projection <- nearest_on_skeleton(as.matrix(df[, c('pt_route1_raw', 'pt_route2_raw')]), s)
df$pt_route1 <- df$pt_route1_raw
df$pt_route2 <- df$pt_route2_raw - (projection$pt2_line - projection$pt1_line)
df <- df %>% mutate(pt_merged = (pt_route1 + pt_route2) / 2, delta = pt_route1 - pt_route2, pt_class = ifelse(pt_merged < fork, 'Shared Trunk', ifelse(w2 < w1, 'Lineage 1', ifelse(w1 < w2, 'Lineage 2', 'Shared Trunk'))))

# population branch skeletons
projection <- nearest_on_skeleton(as.matrix(population[, c('pt_route1', 'pt_route2')]), s)
population$pt_route2 <- population$pt_route2 - (projection$pt2_line - projection$pt1_line)
population <- population %>% mutate(pt_merged = (pt_route1 + pt_route2) / 2, delta = pt_route1 - pt_route2, pt_class = ifelse(pt_merged < fork, 'Shared Trunk', ifelse(w2 < w1, 'Lineage 1', ifelse(w1 < w2, 'Lineage 2', 'Shared Trunk'))))
skeleton <- bind_rows(make_centerline(population, 'Shared Trunk', 'pt_merged', n_bins = 70, span = 0.25), make_centerline(population, 'Lineage 1', 'pt_route1', n_bins = 90, span = 0.30), make_centerline(population, 'Lineage 2', 'pt_route2', n_bins = 90, span = 0.30))

# outliers
df$cl_dist <- NA_real_
for (cl in unique(df$pt_class)) {
    index <- which(df$pt_class == cl)
    s <- skeleton[skeleton$pt_class == cl, ]
    df$cl_dist[index] <- vapply(index, function(i) sqrt(min((s$pt_route1_s - df$pt_route1[i])^2 + (s$pt_route2_s - 
        df$pt_route2[i])^2)), numeric(1))
}
df$cl_far <- df$cl_dist > threshold
noise_sd <- median(df$cl_dist[!df$cl_far], na.rm = TRUE)

path <- file.path(input_dir, 'epithelial_melanoma_outlier_coordinates.csv')
retained <- read.csv(path)
corrected <- correct_trajectory_outliers(list(metadata = df, skeleton = skeleton, noise_sd = noise_sd), retained = retained)

# metadata
corrected$pt_merged <- df$pt_merged
corrected$delta <- df$delta

```

### Final Xenium annotations

```{r final_xenium_annotations}

core <- mel[[]]

# melanoma programs
numeric_fields <- names(modules)
categorical_fields <- c('metaprogram_modulescore_stress_subtype', 'melanoma_mp')
for (field in numeric_fields) metadata[[field]] <- NA_real_
for (field in categorical_fields) metadata[[field]] <- 'Non.Melanoma'
index <- match(rownames(core), rownames(metadata))
for (field in numeric_fields) metadata[[field]][index] <- core[[field]]
for (field in categorical_fields) metadata[[field]][index] <- as.character(core[[field]])
added <- input$metadata
index <- match(added$cell_id, rownames(metadata))
for (field in c(numeric_fields, categorical_fields)) metadata[[field]][index] <- added[[field]]

# trajectories
numeric_fields <- c('DM1', 'DM2', 'DM3', 'pt_route1_raw', 'pt_route2_raw', 'w1', 'w2', 'pt_route1', 'pt_route2', 'pt_merged', 'delta')
categorical_fields <- c('slingshot_lineage_assignment', 'pt_class')
for (field in numeric_fields) metadata[[field]] <- NA_real_
for (field in categorical_fields) metadata[[field]] <- 'Non.Melanoma'
trajectories <- list(trajectory_cells(mel), corrected)
for (trajectory in trajectories) {
    index <- match(trajectory$cell_id, rownames(metadata))
    for (field in c(numeric_fields, categorical_fields)) metadata[[field]][index] <- trajectory[[field]]
}

rm(mel, core, trajectories)
gc()

# figure labels
mp_labels <- c(differentiated_melanocytic = 'Differentiated melanocytic', epithelial_adjacent = 'Epithelial-adjacent', mesenchymal_invasive = 'Mesenchymal invasive', proliferation_cell_cycle = 'Proliferation/cell cycle', early_developmental_stress = 'Early developmental stress', nevus_like_senescence = 'Nevus-like senescence', ifn_associated_stress = 'IFN-associated stress')
metadata$melanoma_mp_labels <- 'Non.Melanoma'
melanoma <- metadata$main_lineage == 'Melanoma'
metadata$melanoma_mp_labels[melanoma] <- unname(mp_labels[metadata$melanoma_mp[melanoma]])
metadata$final_label <- metadata$main_lineage
fields <- c(Epithelial = 'Epithelial_label', Fibroblast = 'Fibroblast_label', Lymphocyte = 'Lymphocyte_label', Myeloid = 'Myeloid_label', Endothelial = 'Endothelial_label', Stroma = 'Stroma_label', Melanoma = 'melanoma_mp')
for (lineage in names(fields)) {
    selected <- metadata$main_lineage == lineage
    metadata$final_label[selected] <- metadata[[fields[[lineage]]]][selected]
}
dictionary <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, 'first_level_lineage_dictionary.csv'))
mast_clusters <- dictionary$cluster[dictionary$main_lineage == 'Mast']
metadata$final_label[metadata$seurat_clusters_split %in% mast_clusters] <- 'Mast'

```

### Metaprograms in the final melanoma embedding

```{r melanoma_metaprogram_embedding}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  mp_pal <- c(differentiated_melanocytic = '#A52A2A', epithelial_adjacent = '#009E73', mesenchymal_invasive = '#FFC0CB', proliferation_cell_cycle = '#CD5C5C', early_developmental_stress = '#DAA520', nevus_like_senescence = '#D55E00', ifn_associated_stress = '#FF7F50')

  path <- file.path(input_dir, 'melanoma_umap.csv')

  df <- read.csv(path)
  df$metaprogram <- metadata$melanoma_mp[match(df$cell_id, rownames(metadata))]

  # embedding panel
  labels <- c(differentiated_melanocytic = 'Melanocytic', epithelial_adjacent = 'Epithelial-adjacent', mesenchymal_invasive = 'MES', proliferation_cell_cycle = 'Proliferative', early_developmental_stress = 'Developmental', nevus_like_senescence = 'Nevus-like', ifn_associated_stress = 'IFN-associated')
  centres <- df %>% group_by(metaprogram) %>% summarise(umap1 = median(umap1), umap2 = median(umap2), .groups = 'drop')
  centres$label <- labels[as.character(centres$metaprogram)]
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(umap1, umap2, colour = metaprogram)) + geom_point_rast(size = 0.3, raster.dpi = 300) +
    geom_label_repel(data = centres, aes(label = label), seed = 1234, size = 3, colour = "black") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = mp_pal) + theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = 'none') + labs(x = 'UMAP 1', y = 'UMAP 2')
  output <- file.path(result_dir, 'Figure_2B_melanoma_embedding.pdf')
  ggsave(output, p, width = 5, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)
}))

```
